name: liceo-sn-robotics-sim
description: Simulador 3D de Arduino Uno R3, ESP32 y Protoboard — Liceo Bicentenario de Excelencia Polivalente San Nicolás (Área Premilitar · Tecnología Geogo)

scripts.test: node -e "import('esbuild').then(e => e.build({entryPoints:['tests/simulator.test.ts'],bundle:true,platform:'node',format:'esm',packages:'external',outfile:'tests/.out.mjs'})).then(() => import('node:child_process').then(cp => { const r = cp.spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--test', 'tests/.out.mjs'], {stdio:'inherit'}); import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('tests/.out.mjs', {force:true})); process.exit(r.status ?? 1); }))"
